parameters.query: SELECT l.id AS listing_id, l.title, l.description, l.tags, l.price, p.niche, p.kind FROM listings l JOIN products p ON p.id = l.product_id WHERE l.id = $1;
INSERT INTO scheduled_posts (listing_id, channel, copy, image_path, scheduled_for, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'queued') RETURNING id, listing_id, channel, scheduled_for, status;

meta.description: POST /webhook/ads-generate {listing_id, channels?, generate_visual?, schedule_at?}. Single Ollama call returns copy for Pinterest/X/Instagram, optional shared visual via workflow 02, fans out one scheduled_posts row per channel.
